hotel_2star_room_2p.sourceTitle: The Best 2 Star Hotels in Cairo from $6 | Expedia
hotel_2star_room_2p.evidenceText: Expedia’s Cairo 2-star page states that price trend information excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed properties with 2 stars in Cairo. Its monthly trend table lists August at $21 per night.
hotel_2star_room_2p.referencePeriod: August 2026 monthly trend; base rates for nightly stays for 2 adults found in the prior 7 days and averaged over commonly viewed 2-star properties
hotel_2star_room_2p.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Cairo Egypt 2-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
hotel_2star_room_2p.reason: Exact city/class, two-adult nightly trend, reference window, currency display, and explicit tax exclusion are present.

hotel_3star_room_2p.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Cairo Egypt 3-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
hotel_3star_room_2p.reason: The ordered search returned no exact-city 3-star class trend with a numeric non-from average, explicit two-adult source trend, and tax-exclusion evidence. General-city trends and unrelated properties were class-ambiguous and rejected.
